4) VAT handling: we need Brightlane's VAT ID and registered billing address to apply the correct EU tax flow (reverse charge vs local VAT).

- Kimberly: confirm VAT routing and any tax memo for our finance team.
- Priyom: I'll loop you when we finalize dates so you can coordinate the drawdown schedule in the billing system.
